body:
Mirthling Jester
CR 4

The jester is a mirthling bard known for his comedic performances and juggling acts. He is always the life of the party, his vibrant attire and eccentric hat making him stand out in any crowd. His performances are not just a means of survival, but also a way to lighten the mood and bring joy to his companions.

Despite his seemingly chaotic demeanor, he often abides by a strict moral code, his actions guided by a deep-seated sense of virtue.

XP 1,200
Mirthling bard 5
CN Medium humanoid (mirthling)
Init +4; Senses Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15 +4 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 30 (5d8+5)
Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee short sword +5 (1d6/19-20)
Ranged light crossbow +6 (1d8/19-20)
Special Attacks bardic performance 13 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate, inspire courage +2, inspire competence +2)
Bard Spells Known (CL 5th; concentration +8)

2nd (3/day)—cure moderate wounds, glitterdust (DC 15), sound burst (DC 15)
1st (5/day)—charm person (DC 14), cure light wounds, hideous laughter (DC 14), unseen servant
0th (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, summon instrument

TACTICS

Before Combat: The jester uses his bardic performance to inspire courage in his allies.

During Combat: The jester prefers to stay at range, using his spells and light crossbow to deal damage while supporting his allies with his bardic performance.

Morale: If reduced to less than 10 hit points, the jester attempts to escape, using his spells and skills to evade his enemies.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 12, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +3, CMD 16
Feats Dodge, Mobility, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +11, Bluff +11, Diplomacy +11, Disguise +11, Perception +8, Perform (comedy) +11, Perform (juggling) +11, Stealth +11
Languages Common, Elven
SQ bardic knowledge +2, versatile performance (comedy), well-versed
Gear short sword, light crossbow, chain shirt, bardic performance tools, spell component pouch, other standard adventuring gear

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Laughter Nourishment (Ex)

The jester does not consume food in the conventional sense. Instead, he is nourished by an observer’s laughter or awe. This unique trait allows him to survive without food as long as he performs successfully for an audience at least once a day.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
